newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut bourse.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut bourse.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares were mixed on Thursday on the Beirut Stock exchange (BSE).
A shares rose to $112 from Wednesday's $111.75, and B shares dropped to $112.25 from $113.625.
Official turnover was 5,200 shares up from Wdnesday's 2,358, and the value of traded shares was $577,357.875 from $262,427.625.
There was a block trade in 59,162 shares of Ciments Libanais at $1.27, slightly down from Tuesday's $1.3125 when 3,000 shares changed hands.
There was no trade in the shares of the three other listed companies: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index was down 0.14 percent to 83.80 and the BLOM stock index was down 0.42 percent to 958.91.
